slices.title: Repair runtime environment initialization
slices.jtbd: When implementing the initialization fix for this epic, I want to repair the Flyway validation and backup script execution, so that the environment successfully launches and passes health checks.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the backend service starts, When Flyway runs migrations, Then it successfully validates or repairs without FlywayValidateException.
Given the backup container starts, When it executes backup.sh, Then it succeeds without permission denied errors.
Given the initialization is complete, When the system health endpoint is polled, Then it returns a healthy status.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% startup success rate with 0 initialization errors
